gen-dafont-college-gf-slabo-13px: College hums along at a flat, constant line weight, dynamic and authoritative. Slabo 13px, a serif with large open counters, would carry pages of text gently, each rounded letter showing a clear opening.
gen-dafont-college-inter: Inter reads smooth, almost tube-like, its counters breathing easily on each line. Down a full column it keeps quiet and steady, leaving College to be the dynamic, authoritative voice up top.
gen-dafont-college-mulish: Modern in manner, Mulish has no stroke modulation at all and a large x-height. And next to College, with its dynamic, authoritative display letters, it feels loose and welcoming.
gen-dafont-conthrax-fs-bespoke-sans: Conthrax stretches a wide-mouthed a across tall lowercase bodies, so the capitals barely rise above them. Bespoke Sans, sharp and refined, should read smoothly down a long column.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-epunda-slab: Conthrax draws its wide-mouthed a with what looks like a single nib, geometric and clean. And Epunda Slab, classic and dignified, keeps paragraphs inviting, its gaping c and tall rounded lowercase leading the eye along.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-glegoo: Glegoo brings big counters and curved letters with unclosed mouths, refined and editorial. Glegoo handles the patient reading work, while Conthrax saves its clean, geometric, wire-like lines for display.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-hanuman: Cable bent into letters: Conthrax holds one unswelling line weight, while Hanuman, a traditional serif, lifts a high-waisted lowercase. Conthrax is best at geometric display; Hanuman is best at refined text.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-kadwa: Geometric and clean, Conthrax keeps a unit-width stroke throughout, while Kadwa opens its curves and enlarges the x-height. Conthrax does display best; Kadwa, a classic serif, does text best.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-piazzolla: Refined and authoritative, Piazzolla reads with lowercase nearly matching the capitals. Piazzolla takes the text beneath Conthrax, whose monoweight stroke gives the top a firm, uniform look.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-pridi: Conthrax draws its g in one unchanging line weight, geometric and clean. But beside Conthrax, Pridi, a classic, refined serif, lets small letters stand proud, almost capital-sized.
